title: worker.registered
description: Emitted when a worker row is INSERTed into the workers table. v0.9.4: emitted by trg_worker_registered_event_emit (renamed from v0.9.3 trg_worker_dispatched_event_emit). Closes Codex v0.9.3 P1-2 finding: the v0.9.3 trigger conflated registration with dispatch; v0.9.4 splits the two events. The actual 'worker.dispatched' event (task->worker assignment) is emitted separately by trg_attempt_dispatched_event_emit_insert on task_attempts INSERT.

worker_id.description: Worker that was registered (TEXT PK in workers table).

host.description: Host identifier where the worker process is running.

status.description: Worker status at registration time. Note: 'draining' is rejected by trg_worker_no_draining_insert (use register then drain lifecycle).

registered_at.description: registered_at timestamp at moment of INSERT.
